description: This file defines a template class 'RecorderType' within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, which implements a recording mechanism for timestamped values with delta compression. It includes nested classes for reading and writing recorded data, handling file storage, and managing measurement data with efficient encoding. The file also includes licensing information and includes several other local headers.

classes.name: RecorderType
classes.description: A template class for recording timestamped values with delta compression, supporting reading and writing of measurement data to files.

classes.name: RecorderType::BaseRecorder
classes.description: A base class managing the core data structure and buffer for recording timestamped values.

classes.name: RecorderType::Writer
classes.description: A class for recording values and writing them to storage files, supporting multiple file segments.

classes.name: RecorderType::Reader
classes.description: A class for reading recorded data from storage files, supporting navigation through recorded measurements.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Stores a timestamped value, calculating and storing deltas relative to previous measurements.

methods.name: StepForward
methods.description: Advances the current measurement to the next data point based on stored deltas.

methods.name: StepBack
methods.description: Moves the current measurement back to the previous data point based on stored deltas.

methods.name: SnapShot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the current recording state into another recorder instance.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads measurement data from a file into the recorder.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves the current measurement data to a file.
